title: 第25章 出门寻宝昆仑芭蕉第26章 顺利得手鲲鹏黑锅
slug: 洪荒开局吞噬十一祖巫
content_zh:
而有了元神，几位大巫在帝江的教导下，以神念沟通天道，感悟法则玄妙，进步神速。
但随之而来的，便是一个崭新的需求！
他们看到帝江偶尔祭出的混沌钟和鸿蒙量天尺，感受到那煌煌威能，不由得对先天灵宝产生了浓厚的兴趣和渴望。
这一日，六位大巫修炼间隙，围坐在帝江身旁。
作为六人中隐隐的领头者，九凤眨了眨她那漂亮的眼睛，带着几分撒娇的意味，开口道：
“大哥~！”
你看我们都大罗金仙了，行走洪荒，总不能空着手吧？您看，是不是也给我们配几件趁手的先天灵宝呀？”
九凤这话一出，旁边的刑天、后羿等人立刻眼巴巴地望了过来，那眼神里充满了期待！
帝江看着这群弟弟妹妹，嘴角微微抽搐。
他手中宝贝确实不少：先天五方旗、五行灵珠、苦竹、造化青莲、混沌钟、鸿蒙量天尺，听起来很豪横！
但问题是，五方旗和五行灵珠是维持笼罩不周山的先天五行五方大阵的核心阵眼，缺一不可，动一个阵法威力就大减，根本不能拿来送人。
苦竹刚刚种下，造化青莲更是心头肉，混沌钟和鸿蒙量天尺是他自己的武器，总不能拆了分吧！
算来算去，他竟然拿不出一件多余的，适合送人的先天灵宝！
至于不周山本身？他早就用神念犁地般扫过无数遍了。
但凡像点样的先天灵宝，恐怕早在龙汉初劫甚至更早的时候，就被那些嗅觉灵敏的先天神魔们搜刮干净了，还能留到现在等他？
至于被他放走的那些先天灵根，虽然可以当做灵宝，但是与他们大道不甚契合，不然帝江是高低是不会轻易放他们离去的！
他当然也可以炼制一些后天灵宝，而且，炼制的后天灵宝也会更加契合他们。
不过，帝江不擅长炼器，目前根本炼制不出他自认为品级合适，而也让这群大巫感觉强大趁手的后天灵宝！
送给自家弟弟妹妹的第一件礼物，是后天灵宝当然没问题，毕竟灵宝的核心在于契合自身，但是要是送一帮废铜烂铁，这要是传出去，他堂堂帝江的面子往哪搁？弟弟妹妹心里会不会觉得大哥小气无能？
看着弟弟妹妹们那殷切的眼神，帝江心中哀叹，表面却还得维持兄长的威严。

他清了清嗓子，摆出一副高深莫测的样子：
“咳，灵宝不过是身外之物，乃是护道之器，而非根本。
尔等切莫过于依赖外物，当以自身修为、感悟法则为重！”
然而，心直口快、肌肉比脑子转得快的夸父，挠了挠他那睿智的脑袋，瓮声瓮气地来了句：“大哥，你说这么多该不会是你自己也没有灵宝了吧？”
噗——！
这话如同精准的一箭，直接扎在了帝江的心窝子上！
他脸色瞬间一黑！
“胡说八道！
为兄岂会没有灵宝？只是时机未到！
尔等如今修为尚浅，即便给了你们强大的灵宝，也难以发挥其威力，反而可能招来祸患！”
帝江目光扫过众人，给出了一个自以为靠谱的承诺：“这样，待尔等修为突破至大罗金仙中后期，或者能够熟练掌控法则之力时，为兄便亲自为你们挑选、赐下合适的先天灵宝！
如何？”
这个理由听起来合情合理！
九凤等人互相看了看，虽然觉得可能要等一段时间，但大哥既然承诺了，他们也只能按下急切的心情，齐声应道：“是，大哥！
我们定会努力修炼！”
总算暂时稳住了这群小鬼，帝江心中却是一刻也坐不住了。
不行！
这脸不能丢！
必须想办法搞点灵宝来！
帝江眼珠一转，计上心来。

趁着弟弟妹妹们再次沉浸到修炼中时，悄无声息地分出一具身外化身。
这化身拥有他部分法力和神识，坐镇盘古神殿，足以应付日常事务和教导弟妹。
以他混元金仙的修为，留下的化身，这几个大罗初期的小家伙根本看不穿。
而帝江的本尊，则收敛了全部气息，悄咪咪地溜出了不周山，融入茫茫洪荒之中。
离开了不周山，帝江隐匿于空间夹层之中，一边疾行，一边思索。
content_en:
With the Yuanshen, several great witches, under the guidance of Di Jiang, communicated with the way of heaven with their spiritual thoughts, understood the mysterious laws, and made rapid progress.
But what followed was a brand new demand!
They saw the Chaos Bell and the Hongmeng Heavenly Ruler that Di Jiang occasionally offered, and felt the brilliant power, and couldn't help but develop a strong interest and desire for the innate spiritual treasure.
On this day, the six great witches sat around Di Jiang during a break from practicing.
As the faint leader among the six, Jiufeng blinked her beautiful eyes and said with a hint of coquettishness:
"Brother~!"
You see, we are all Da Luo Jinxian. We can’t walk empty-handed, right? Look, are you also going to give us some handy innate spiritual treasures? "
As soon as Jiufeng said this, Xing Tian, Hou Yi and others next to him immediately looked over eagerly, their eyes full of expectation!
Di Jiang looked at these younger brothers and sisters, and the corners of his mouth twitched slightly.
There are indeed many treasures in his hands: the Xiantian Five Directions Flag, the Five Elements Spirit Pearl, the Bitter Bamboo, the Creation Green Lotus, the Chaos Bell, and the Hongmeng Heavenly Ruler. It sounds very arrogant!
But the problem is that the Five Directions Flag and the Five Elements Spirit Pearl are the core formations that maintain the innate Five Elements and Five Directions Formation that covers Buzhou Mountain. They are indispensable. The power of the formation will be greatly reduced if it is used, and it cannot be given away at all.
The Bitter Bamboo had just been planted, and the Creation Green Lotus was his favorite. The Chaos Bell and the Hongmeng Sky Ruler were his own weapons, so they couldn't be separated!
After much calculation, he couldn't come up with an extra innate spiritual treasure suitable for giving away!
As for Buzhou Mountain itself? He had already plowed through it countless times with his spiritual thoughts.
Any kind of innate spiritual treasures might have been plundered by those innate gods and demons with a keen sense of smell as early as the first calamity of Long Han or even earlier. How could they still be kept waiting for him now?
As for the innate spiritual roots he let go, although they can be regarded as spiritual treasures, they are not in line with their great ways. Otherwise, Di Jiang would not let them go easily!
Of course, he can also refine some acquired spiritual treasures, and the refined acquired spiritual treasures will be more suitable for them.
However, Di Jiang is not good at refining weapons. Currently, he cannot refine the acquired spiritual treasure that he thinks is of the right grade, which also makes these great witches feel powerful!
Of course, it’s okay to give the first gift to his younger brothers and sisters, the acquired Lingbao. After all, the core of the Lingbao is to suit oneself, but if it’s a bunch of scrap metal, if word spreads about it, where will his majestic Emperor Jiang’s face go? Will the younger siblings feel that the elder brother is stingy and incompetent?
Looking at the earnest eyes of his younger brothers and sisters, Di Jiang lamented in his heart, but on the surface he still had to maintain his brother's dignity.
He cleared his throat and put on an enigmatic look:
"Ahem, the spiritual treasure is just an external thing, a tool to protect the Tao, not the root.
You must not rely too much on external things. You should focus on your own cultivation and understanding of the laws! "
However, Kuafu, who was outspoken and whose muscles moved faster than his brain, scratched his wise head and said angrily: "Brother, if you say so much, is it because you don't have a spiritual treasure yourself? "
Poof——!
These words were like a precise arrow, piercing Di Jiang's heart directly!
His face turned dark instantly!
"Nonsense!
How can I, my brother, not have a spiritual treasure? It’s just that the time hasn’t come yet!
Your current cultivation level is still shallow. Even if you are given a powerful spiritual treasure, you will not be able to exert its power. Instead, it may cause disaster! "
Di Jiang glanced at everyone and made a promise that he thought was reliable: "In this way, when your cultivation reaches the mid-to-late stage of Da Luo Jinxian, or you are able to master the power of laws, I will personally select and give you suitable innate spiritual treasures!
how? "
This reason sounds reasonable!
Jiufeng and others looked at each other. Although they thought it might take a while, since the eldest brother had promised, they could only suppress their eagerness and responded in unison: "Yes,Brother!
We will definitely practice hard! "
Finally, the group of brats were temporarily stabilized, but Di Jiang couldn't sit still for a moment.
No!
Don't lose this face!
We must find a way to get some spiritual treasures!
Di Jiang rolled his eyes, and his plan came to his mind.
While the younger brothers and sisters were immersed in cultivation again, an external incarnation was quietly separated.
This incarnation possesses part of his magic power and spiritual consciousness, and sits in Pangu Temple, which is enough to handle daily affairs and teach his younger brothers and sisters.
With his cultivation as a Hunyuan Golden Immortal, these little guys in the early stages of Daluo couldn't even see through the incarnations he left behind.
Di Jiang's true form, on the other hand, restrained all his aura, quietly slipped out of Buzhou Mountain, and blended into the vast wilderness.
After leaving Buzhou Mountain, Dijiang hid in the interlayer of space, thinking while running fast.
